name: sidebar
description: Lets Claude read your Sidebar meeting notes, transcripts, matters and time entries.
long_description: Ask Claude about your recorded meetings: "What did the judge order in Smith v. Jones?", "Draft a reporting letter from yesterday's hearing", "List my time entries for this week". Read-only. Works only when "Let Claude read my meetings" is turned on in Sidebar's Settings, and never while Sidebar is locked.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List recorded meetings, optionally by matter or date

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Search titles, notes and full transcripts

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get a meeting's notes, time entry, flagged moments and optionally its transcript

tools.name: get_time_entries
tools.description: Get drafted time entries and total hours for a period or matter
